name: Nuwber
tip: Tap FIND ME ON THIS SITE (tap I Agree if asked). If a listing is you, tap View details, not Get full report. At the bottom tap Remove My Info, which fills in the link, then tap Opt out. Check the details, enter your email and tap Remove. Nothing happens until you tap Confirm request in their email. If nothing there is you, tap NOT LISTED.

name: PublicDataUSA
tip: Search your name on the site and open your listing if one is there, then copy that page's link. On the opt-out page enter your name and email, paste the link, do the CAPTCHA and tap Continue. Finish with the link or code they email or text you. If nothing there is you, tap NOT LISTED.

name: PeopleSmart
tip: Its list is separate from BeenVerified's, so it needs its own opt-out. Search your name, city and state, tap Optout on the record that is you, enter your email, do the human check and tap Send Verification Email. Nothing is removed until you tap the link in their email.

name: FamFinder
tip: Family-tree style people search. Enter your first name, last name and state and tap Search. Tap Proceed to Opt Out on your record (check the age and places), enter your email, do the human check and tap Send Verification Email. Nothing is removed until you tap VERIFY OPT-OUT in their email, which can take hours.

name: NeighborWho (who lives where)
tip: Shows who lives at an address. Search your name and state, tap Proceed to Opt Out on your record, enter your email, do the human check and tap Send Verification Email. Nothing is removed until you tap the link in their email.

name: Ownerly (property records)
tip: Home and property records tied to your name. Search your name and state, tap Proceed to Opt Out on your record, enter your email, do the human check and tap Send Verification Email. Nothing is removed until you tap the link in their email.

name: Homemetry (address records)
tip: Shows who lives at each address. Search your street address and open your home's record. Tap Information Control, tap Remove on each item about you, then Apply. Enter your name and email, then tap the link they email you. If your address is not there, tap NOT LISTED.

name: CocoFinder
tip: Search your name, city and state on the site. If a record is you, tap check details and copy that page's link. The removal page links to a short form for your name, email and that link. If the form makes you sign in to Google, tap SEND EMAIL REQUEST instead. If nothing there is you, tap NOT LISTED.

name: NumberGuru (phone lookup)
tip: Reverse phone lookup. Search for yourself, tap Proceed to Opt Out on your record, enter your email, do the human check and tap Send Verification Email. Nothing is removed until you tap Verify Opt-Out in their email, which can be slow to arrive.

name: NumLookup (phone lookup)
tip: Reverse phone lookup. Enter your phone number, do the CAPTCHA and tap Remove My Info. Then tap Manually Submit Removal Request and fill in your email, full name, state and phone. Type Remove My Info as the subject and description, do the CAPTCHA and tap Submit. Allow about 2 weeks.

name: Spy Dialer (phone lookup)
tip: Reverse phone lookup that puts names to numbers. Its web removal form has been failing its human check, so tap SEND EMAIL REQUEST. The email includes the phone number from your details. You can also call them at (866) 834-2579.

name: Hiya (caller ID on Samsung phones)
tip: Hiya supplies the caller ID and spam labels on Samsung phones. Fill in the form with your email and phone number and ask them to remove your name from caller ID. They say requests take up to 30 days.

name: ContactOut (work contacts)
tip: Sells work emails and phone numbers to recruiters. Enter your email and tap Send verification link. Tap the link in their email and follow the steps to remove your profile. They say it is deleted within 24 hours. If they find nothing for you, tap NOT LISTED.

name: SignalHire (work contacts)
tip: Work-contact database built from LinkedIn and other sites. Tap SEND EMAIL REQUEST to have them delete you. Their web form needs a work email and the link to your SignalHire profile, so the email is easier. They say requests take 30 to 45 days.

name: Wiland (marketing data)
tip: Marketing data co-op that pools shopping and donation records. Choose I want to opt out of marketing programs or delete personal information for myself. Fill in your name, email and address, tick I Certify, do the CAPTCHA and tap Submit. Then tap Confirm Email in their email.

name: Alliant (marketing data)
tip: Marketing data co-op that pools customer lists from many companies. Fill in your first name, last name and email, do the CAPTCHA and tap Submit, then tap Confirm Email in their email. That stops them selling your data. To have them delete it too, also tap SEND EMAIL REQUEST.

name: Path2Response (marketing data)
tip: Marketing data co-op built from catalog orders and donations. The same form handles delete and do not sell, so choose delete if it asks. Fill in your name, email and address and submit, then tap Confirm Email in their email.

name: Zeta Global (marketing data)
tip: Marketing data tied to your email address. Say you are asking for yourself, tick both delete and do not sell or share, enter your name, email and country, tick I'm not a robot and tap Submit. Then tap Confirm Email in their email. They take 30 to 90 days.

name: Accurate Append (data append)
tip: Adds phone numbers and emails to other companies' customer lists. Fill in your name, street address, city, state, zip, phone and email, wait for the green Success check and tap SUBMIT. Each extra address, phone or email needs its own request. Their confirmation email should come within minutes.

name: Kochava (phone location data)
tip: Sells location data collected through phone apps. Choose Delete My Data + Opt Me Out and fill in your email, name and address. Add your phone's advertising ID too: in Settings search for Ads and open the Google one to copy it. Tap Submit request. Afterwards tap Delete advertising ID on that Ads screen.
